assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production raster sprite atlas for a landscape Android tactical FPS named OniRoai. Create one square 1536 by 1536 PNG with a genuinely transparent background. Exactly a 3-column by 3-row grid of separate centered assets, each cell 512 by 512, each asset isolated with at least 45 px clear transparent padding. NO words, letters, numbers, grid lines or captions. Row 1: (left) a large hollow circular joystick base ring, open transparent center, precision machined dark gunmetal with realistic brushed metal bevel and thin muted cyan accent; (center) matching convex circular joystick thumb cap, rubberized graphite with subtle tactile cross grooves and realistic dimensional lighting; (right) a matching hollow circular FIRE control base ring, open transparent center, dark machined gunmetal with restrained amber accent. Row 2: (left) convex circular fire thumb cap with an embossed realistic rifle bullet icon; (center) compact circular button with sculpted silver crouching soldier pictogram; (right) matching button with sculpted silver jumping soldier pictogram. Row 3: (left) matching button with embossed scope crosshair pictogram; (center) matching button with embossed sprinting soldier pictogram; (right) matching smaller pause button with two embossed vertical bars. These must be clean photographic 3D rendered mobile game UI components, front-facing orthographic view, consistent soft overhead light, near-black graphite, worn steel, restrained cyan/amber, realistic microtexture, crisp silhouettes. Keep all buttons readable at 80 to 200 display pixels. No plastic toy look, neon bloom, skull ornamentation, large opaque rectangular backdrops, firearms in the joystick, or baked in shadows beyond each asset. The ring holes and the outside of every asset must be truly transparent. The output will be used directly as a game texture atlas, not as a whole screen mockup.

Use case: ui-mockup. Production raster HUD texture sheet for original tactical FPS OniRoai. 1536x1536 PNG, genuinely transparent background. Front orthographic photographic 3D rendered interface components, subtle precision milled gunmetal, satin graphite, bevel edges, frosted dark inset glass, realistic micro scratches, slim desaturated cyan and amber indicator strips. Three isolated horizontal rows with large transparent gutters. Top row: a wide elegant competitive score module, centered at x768 y230, outer bounds approximately x100..1436 y70..390, aspect about 4:1. It has two dark EMPTY side wells and a small central divider, muted cyan accents on left and muted warm amber on right; leave the interior empty and mostly dark translucent for runtime score labels. Middle row: one wide weapon/ammunition module, centered x768 y760, outer bounds approximately x150..1386 y540..970, about 3:1. A dark EMPTY glass left compartment for a gun picture, EMPTY right area for live ammunition digits, a narrow empty lower inset for reload progress. Bottom row: a separate realistic side profile MP5 A5 firearm with compact scope attached, clean photographed black steel, stock, magazine, trigger and barrel clearly defined; centered x768 y1260 within x170..1366 y1100..1420, facing right, isolated transparent background. NO text, letters, digits, ammo numbers, labels, logos, no mock interface screenshots, no grid lines. Preserve clear negative space in panels: dynamic typography is added by the actual game. Crisp at small size, professional restrained military instrument design, no toy plastic, no excessive decoration.

Use case: logo-brand. Create the actual launcher/avatar icon for an original 3D tactical shooter named OniRoai. Square 1024x1024, premium photographic 3D emblem render. A powerful original oni-inspired tactical helmet / armored face mask with two short angular horn-like armor fins, blackened brushed steel, restrained amber eyes or visor slit, tiny cyan reflected rim light, realistic scratched metal and dark fabric detailing. Symmetrical strong readable silhouette in the middle 70 percent of the image so Android adaptive icon cropping is safe. Deep midnight navy and charcoal softly textured background, cinematic controlled studio light, vivid enough to read at 96 pixels. No gore, no real military insignia, no commercial game characters. NO text, letters, numbers, watermarks or outer border. Mature, elegant, convincing materials rather than cartoon or plastic. This is a single finished game icon, not a sheet of options.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original landscape loading-screen background illustration for the tactical FPS OniRoai, 1536x1024 or wide landscape. Cinematic grounded military game key art: a lone anonymous armored scout in a dark oni-inspired tactical helmet seen from behind in the RIGHT third, carrying a compact black MP5 with optic low against the body, approaching a weathered small stone guard outpost among realistic mossy boulders, sparse fir trees and ferns. Cool mist after rain, dawn sunlight filtering through trees, restrained amber lamps, worn fabric and believable metal materials. Keep the LEFT half and lower 20 percent quiet and dark with atmospheric negative space for a game title and loading status added at runtime. Wide natural composition, detailed photographic PBR illustration, subtle depth and volumetric light, no cartoon look. No text, no letters, no logos, no fake loading bar, no game interface, no gore, no commercial game references. The image is loading art, not a screenshot of gameplay.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production VFX sprite sheet for an original realistic tactical FPS named OniRoai, actual transparent PNG, square, 2 columns and 2 rows with four isolated effects and ample clear transparent padding in each quadrant. Top left: a very small, sharp photographic muzzle flash from the front of a suppressed-size compact submachine gun, bright warm white center, restrained amber prongs and tiny sparks, approximately circular front view, organic irregular translucent edges, no weapon. Top right: a second natural asymmetric variation of the same tiny muzzle flash, front view. Bottom left: a thin soft translucent gray gun smoke wisp, backlit, subtle and airy, no opaque background. Bottom right: a second thin gun smoke wisp variation. Nothing else. No text, digits, grid lines, backgrounds, bloom field, huge fireball, explosions or weapons. These are sprites scaled to only about 8 to 40 screen pixels at the muzzle, not large cinematic explosions; realistic high-speed-photography textures with actual transparent edges. Keep quadrant assets separate, centered, no overlap.
